No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in the paper. LLMs were only used for paraphrasing (pre-processing), not for evaluating outputs.

overall_notes: Paper focuses on MT evaluation in healthcare domain. Human evaluation was primary method, with limited automatic metric use (BLEU only for Amharic GHI). LLMs were used for paraphrasing intervention but not as evaluators. Metadata extraction was generally accurate but needed refinement on what constituted evaluated NLG tasks vs. pre-processing methods.
